tests.name: desktop 1280/1440, signed in, ?spotlight=1: every static member screen this phase migrated (Memory, Timeline, Recall, Permissions, Settings Privacy/Preferences, My Journey, Business Hub + sections, Opportunities, Listings, AI Picks, Marketplace, a category list, provider detail, Inbox Archived/Inspiration, Search, Members, Open Asks, Find a Match, Talk to Vitana, Event Game, Creator onboarded, My Tickets, Distribution, Patient results) is framed with its manifest archetype, keeps the sidebar chrome, shows no page spinner after load, shows exactly one spotlight card on dashboard/storefront/detail screens and has no horizontal scroll in LTR and RTL; nothing that writes is clicked

flag on/off switch per screen (legacy screen unchanged with the flag off, compact header + archetype frame with it on), sample content left out on Spotlight (Recall, Permissions, Archived, Distribution, provider, patient health/appointments), honest empty states, My Journey hero (loading skeleton, no-goal text-only spotlight, error retry, real progress line, compact rail), Business Hub hero and real-only ledger, product detail body (skeleton, not-found, one spotlight + real sections), shared states; legacy suites of GroupChat, LiveRoomViewer, Privacy and Patient results still green with the flag off
tests.reason: Loading, empty, error and no-goal states, the flag-off legacy path and the parameterised screens (product, group chat, live room) depend on data the read-only staging account cannot control; the unit suites pin them deterministically, staging proves the real frames end to end.

tests.name: public, auth, legal and commerce-portal screens with ?spotlight=1: signed out at 390/1280/1440 px in LTR and RTL every public screen (landing, Maxina/Alkalma portals, reset password, privacy, terms, apply, commerce login, Maxina app, Exafy admin, Maxina support, download, commerce portal/join/connect/privacy, cinematic intro) is framed with its manifest archetype from 1024 px up and not framed on the phone, has no horizontal scroll and no page spinner after load; privacy and terms show the same legal text with Spotlight on and off; signed in, invite, package success, cart, commerce team and health orders keep their frame (and the sidebar where the app shell renders); the professional/staff placeholders render the workspace frame for an account with the role and stay gated for one without it; nothing is submitted and no sign-in/sign-up/OAuth button is clicked

flag on/off per public, auth, legal, commerce and operator-placeholder page: today’s tree with the flag off, the manifest archetype with it on (reset password, logout, operator and /patient placeholders, init-events, news detail with one spotlight card), legal text unchanged by the frame, every page of this phase composes ScreenFrame behind useSpotlightEnabled() with its manifest archetype, no raw shadcn Card except the cart
tests.reason: The auth hand-off screens (/logout, /oauth/complete, /oauth/consent, the e-mail confirmation pages) sign out or consume auth state when opened, and the professional/staff, /patient and /partner/connections screens need roles the read-only staging account does not have; the unit suite renders them deterministically, the staging spec proves the reachable frames end to end.
